summary: Farmers Fishers Bakers is confirmed at 3000 K Street NW in Georgetown. All 97 frozen January 2024 lunch/dinner rows reconcile once against five current March-July 2026 location menus: 66 exact, 11 renamed, and 20 stale. The current POC boundary expands to 253 unique food and nonalcoholic products across First Bake, weekday breakfast, buffet brunch, lunch/dinner, and dessert. No formal allergen matrix was found after all four searches; direct ingredient positives and the restaurant's strong cross-contact warning are preserved without inferring absent allergens.
proposedChanges: Replace the January 2024 lunch/dinner-only projection with the current five-surface Georgetown catalog.
Normalize renamed presentations and retire products absent from all current menus.
Add First Bake, weekday breakfast, buffet brunch, current lunch/dinner, dessert, and nonalcoholic beverage products.
Preserve direct ingredient positives and the current severe-allergy cross-contact warning; leave undisclosed allergens unavailable.

findings.finding: The frozen catalog covers only an older lunch/dinner PDF and omits four active service/menu surfaces.
Current July 2026 menus rename or retire multiple January 2024 products.
Every current menu warns that a scratch kitchen cannot guarantee safety for severe allergies susceptible to cross-contact.
